title: WhatsApp: documented voice feedback
role_for_mira: Supplementary documentation of familiar voice-state indicators.

provenance.kind: feature graphics; not sequential flow evidence

target_reference.units: logical design units, not measured donor dp

spatial_ergonomic.measurement_basis: Qualitative visual reading of retained frames. Regions below are relative roles; source screenshots/GIFs do not expose device density or reliable native dp. Marketing/device chrome is not counted as app content.

regions.description: Multiple chat/control examples and callout labels share one publisher graphic; no single native viewport can be measured.

spatial_ergonomic.reference_zone_status: Proposed comparison grid only; donor controls may fall outside these bands. Not a fixed-coordinate implementation rule.

visual_density.value: Not applicable to a native viewport: multi-example feature diagram.

states_and_triggers.limitation: Visible states are observations; documented arrows use source flow/guide descriptions. No event-handler names, gesture thresholds, or unseen screens are inferred as measured behavior.

observation.value: Static official feature graphics document capability; exact visual transitions, dimensions, and timings are unknown.

visual_or_documented_feedback.value: Voice playback and waveform visualization are documented. A waveform alone does not prove speech recognition or successful transmission; haptics are unknown.

hierarchy.value: Feature labels distinguish recording, draft preview, and playback. Publisher marketing captions are not in-app copy measurements.

copy_and_cognitive_load.note: No OCR word-count or grade-level measurement is claimed. Use the Mira copy sheet for exact comparison text.

mira_synthesis_candidate.value: Make actual voice capture obvious and keep a visible text route. Preserve Mira hold/release behavior; pause/preview/mic-lock features are not silently added.
